<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**11** anchor(s) derived from **4** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them. ⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/data.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/data.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/data.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/data.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **215** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **155** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **155**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **100** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **139** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json bc80e16260597d52b062b7e1ee810c7b9a99aed2` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `aa0e12f57e7910818b253a5b988d1e6e29edfa33` — the merge of head `b88ca46d901e0b7d509b89e716b6a89a885d359b` into base `bc80e16260597d52b062b7e1ee810c7b9a99aed2`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin aa0e12f57e7910818b253a5b988d1e6e29edfa33 && git checkout aa0e12f57e7910818b253a5b988d1e6e29edfa33
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin bc80e16260597d52b062b7e1ee810c7b9a99aed2 b88ca46d901e0b7d509b89e716b6a89a885d359b && git checkout -B drift-repro bc80e16260597d52b062b7e1ee810c7b9a99aed2 && git merge --no-ff b88ca46d901e0b7d509b89e716b6a89a885d359b

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json bc80e16260597d52b062b7e1ee810c7b9a99aed2
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `049b3a6c95fa9a8b4743d7d0496c5f0349ead6a7`

Scope: 17 files (+1017/−16) on merge base `8d76c2d38c`:
- `packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts`: one new export plus the `LIKE_DESCRIPTION` edit, with its three generated artifacts;
- four driver doors, five new pins and two seam-pin rows;
- `.changeset/20041-like-nul-pattern-refused.md`, and one rewritten bullet of the pending `.changeset/20024-sqlite-glob-stored-nul.md`.

Read: card #20041 and its comments, #20024, PR #20038 and its record, #20039, PR #20093 and its record 5826632400, PR #20104 and its record 5827309177 (the Clause-② precedent), the PR body, the diff, all 35 check-runs, AGENTS.md, `contract-review.md`, `landing-operations.md`, `clause2-line.mjs`, `check-empty-changeset.mjs` and `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`.

Measured in detached worktrees at head and at base, plus a third worktree of `origin/main` merged with the head.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Every face, base → head: RIGHT.** Each face got 10 U+0000 patterns across positions and marks (80 cells) and 9 NUL-free controls (36 cells), with `@objectstack/formula` as the oracle.
  - At base, the five SQLite faces (`SqlDriver`, `SqliteWasmDriver`, `TursoDriver` local, remote over the stub, remote over a real libSQL client) differed from formula in 20/20 bare and `$not` cells and refused none. Their answers were identical across all five.
  - `InMemoryDriver.find`, its QueryAST like/ilike arm and `match()` answered correctly at base.
  - At head, all eight driver faces refuse 80/80 with `INVALID_FILTER` / 400, own keys `code,status`. The two remote faces send 0 `FROM` statements, and the pg / mysql2 compile pins refuse on the walk before a dialect.
  - The controls are byte-identical at base and head, 36/36 on every face.
  - A dangling escape keeps its own refusal beside U+0000.
- **The spec predicate: RIGHT.** `hasNulInLikePattern` sits directly after `hasDanglingLikeEscape`, which is byte-identical. The converters are unchanged.
- **The public surface gains exactly one addition:** `hasNulInLikePattern` on `@objectstack/spec/data` (`api-surface/data.json` +1). The driver-side builders are module-private or `private`.
- **The withheld seam: RIGHT.**
  - Policy and unmarked messages are byte-identical, and no non-author cell leaks the operator variant, field, path or pattern. The log carries them, with U+0000 escaped.
  - Author-marked callers on the local faces get the full text. Turso remote withholds for authors, the declared #20093 cost.
  - The seam enumeration counts move by exactly the two new builders. The seam pins pass 95/95 (`driver-sql`) and 102/102 (remote).
- **The ablations reproduce the PR's numbers exactly**, each restored by blob:
  - A, the predicate never true: sql-20041 75 failed / 9 passed, the sql seam 4 / 91, wasm 10 / 6, turso 8 / 9, the remote seam 6 / 96, memory 15 / 6. The dangling-escape suites stay green.
  - B, the builders bypassing the seam: `driver-sql` 78 failed of 179, including both enumeration assertions; the remote seam 6 failed of 102.
- **Census and generated files: RIGHT.** `hasNulInLikePattern(` has 0 call sites at base and 5 at head. `check:generated` reports all 15 up to date.
- **Pins at head:** spec 5/5, `driver-sql` 201/201, `driver-turso` 119/119, wasm 16/16, memory 36/36. On the tree merged with current `main`, the turso pins pass 179/179.
- **CI at this head:** 35 runs, 32 `success`, 2 `skipped`, 1 failure, and all seven required contexts are `success`. The one failure is `Check Changeset`, on the foreign-changeset rule for `.changeset/20024-sqlite-glob-stored-nul.md`: exactly the declared correction.

### ② Semver level

- `minor` for `@objectstack/spec` and the four drivers, with BREAKING and a `!` title: CONSISTENT with an accept-set narrowing under the launch-window convention.
- **`Clause-②: no (narrowing)` is a FALSE declaration. It must read `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`.**
  - The PR widens the public surface by one export, `hasNulInLikePattern` on `@objectstack/spec/data`, as its own changeset says.
  - By AGENTS.md's rule and the PR #20104 precedent (record 5827309177), a new public export is a widening, so the value is `yes`.
  - The level, the BREAKING banner and the ADR-0087 marker do not move.
- **ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`: CORRECT.** Nothing an author can write is removed or renamed. The narrowing is of pattern values, and the refusal text and the changeset carry the one-line fix.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **DELIBERATE CORRECTION confirmed for this head** (`.changeset/20024-sqlite-glob-stored-nul.md`, the last bullet of "What does not change"):
  - **Base sentence**, "… and a pattern holding U+0000 is still cut there": its final clause is FALSE at head. 80/80 U+0000 pattern cells are refused on every SQLite face before any statement is sent.
  - **Head sentence 1**, "`$like` and `$ilike` still compile to `GLOB` on SQLite, so they still read a stored value only up to its first U+0000": TRUE. The emitters are untouched, and the stored-NUL control cells still differ from formula.
  - **Head sentence 2**, "A pattern holding U+0000 is no longer cut there: every driver that answers `$like` now refuses it (`INVALID_FILTER` / 400), by its own entry in this release": TRUE.
  - The `Check Changeset` red is this correction and nothing else. The confirmation binds to `049b3a6c95`; a new head needs its own at-tier record, which repeats it.
- **Changeset `20041-like-nul-pattern-refused.md`:** every measured sentence is TRUE except the line `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` (see ②).
- **PR body: TRUE except two sentences.**
  - `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, in the header and in H5.
  - The Acceptance note "`main` moved 3 commits past the merge base … none touches a path of this PR". `main` was already 6 commits past the base at PR creation, and PR #20114 touches `remote-transport.ts` and its seam pin. The merge is clean, and the merged-tree pins pass.
- **The dev's out-of-scope findings are REAL and correctly left.** `query-syntax.mdx` names only the dangling escape (incomplete, not false), and so does `skills/objectstack-query/rules/filters.md`.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-20041-like-nul-pattern-refused`
Reviewed-by: `session_01Bvd69VPa6puiNzzPUroDBx`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

Must-change (text only; every measured behaviour is RIGHT):
1. `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` → `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` in the PR body (the header and H5) and in `.changeset/20041-like-nul-pattern-refused.md`. Keep `minor`, BREAKING, the `!` title and the ADR-0087 marker.
2. Correct the Acceptance note on `main`: name the commits and PR #20114's two `driver-turso` paths, with the merged-tree reading, or drop the sentence.
3. The new head needs its own at-tier record, which repeats the DELIBERATE CORRECTION confirmation, before the `Check Changeset` red may ride in.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `b88ca46d901e0b7d509b89e716b6a89a885d359b`

Scope: the delta over FAIL 5828387721 (`049b3a6c95`), plus the patched PR body and the seat's claim amendment 5828886919. Two commits:
- `2b8dd90200`, a merge of `origin/main` `6780e34af5`;
- `b88ca46d90`, one line of `.changeset/20041-like-nul-pattern-refused.md`: `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` → `yes (narrowing)`.

Measured in a detached worktree at `b88ca46d90`, with the driver closures rebuilt.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Must-change 1 (`Clause-②`): MET.**
  - The changeset and the PR body (the header and H5) read `yes (narrowing)`. `minor`, BREAKING, the `!` title and the ADR-0087 marker are unchanged.
  - `check-changeset-no-major --base 6780e34af5 --event <PR payload>`: "✓ This diff introduces no `major` bump." and "✓ LEVEL AXIS: this PR declares clause-② `yes (narrowing)` …" (exit 0).
  - `check-adr-0087-registration --base 6780e34af5`: "✓ … 1 declared-breaking changeset(s), each carrying an ADR-0087 disposition." (exit 0).
- **Must-change 2 (the Acceptance note on `main`): MET, every clause TRUE.**
  - `git log --first-parent 8d76c2d38c..6780e34af5` is exactly the 10 commits the note names.
  - Only `55daf89d74` (PR #20114) touches a path of this PR: `remote-transport.ts` and its seam pin.
  - The merge commit's tree equals `git merge-tree --write-tree 049b3a6c95 6780e34af5`, so there were no conflicts.
  - `git diff --shortstat 6780e34af5 b88ca46d90`: 17 files, +1017/−16, the same file list as before the merge.
- **The merge is behaviour-neutral for this PR.** On the merged head, `@objectstack/formula` is the oracle:
  - Every face refuses 20/20 U+0000 cells with `INVALID_FILTER` / 400, own keys `code,status`. The faces are `SqlDriver`, `SqliteWasmDriver`, `TursoDriver` local, remote over the stub, remote over real libSQL, and `InMemoryDriver.find`; `match()` refuses 10/10.
  - The NUL-free controls match the oracle, and only those 18 statements reach the real libSQL engine.
  - `remote-transport.ts` holds both doors: `nulLikePattern`, and #20114's `$between` arity arm.
  - Pins: the remote seam 136/136, turso-20041 17/17, full `driver-turso` 69 files / 1663 tests, the `driver-sql` seam plus 20041 179/179, wasm 16/16, memory 36/36, spec 31/31. `check:generated` reports all 15 up to date.
- **The public surface change is still exactly one export,** `hasNulInLikePattern` on `@objectstack/spec/data`.
- **CI at this head:** 42 runs, 36 `success`, 4 `skipped`, 2 `failure`, 0 pending. All seven required contexts are `success`.
  - The two failures are the same job, `Check Changeset`, run once per `pull_request` run of this head (the push, then the body edit).
  - Both logs name only `.changeset/20024-sqlite-glob-stored-nul.md exists on the merge base and was not added by this PR`, the #17712 foreign-changeset rule.

### ② Semver level

- `minor` for the five packages, with BREAKING and the `!` title: CONSISTENT.
- `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`: CORRECT, in the changeset, the PR body and the amended claim.
- ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`: CORRECT, and unchanged.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **DELIBERATE CORRECTION confirmed on `b88ca46d90`** (`.changeset/20024-sqlite-glob-stored-nul.md`, the last bullet of "What does not change"), re-measured on this head:
  - **Base sentence**, "… and a pattern holding U+0000 is still cut there": its final clause is FALSE at head. 20/20 U+0000 cells are refused on every SQLite face, with no statement sent.
  - **Head sentence 1**, "`$like` and `$ilike` still compile to `GLOB` on SQLite, so they still read a stored value only up to its first U+0000": TRUE. Every control statement holds `GLOB`, and the stored-U+0000 control cells still differ from the oracle (#20024 item 2 (ii)).
  - **Head sentence 2**, "A pattern holding U+0000 is no longer cut there: every driver that answers `$like` now refuses it (`INVALID_FILTER` / 400), by its own entry in this release": TRUE on all six faces.
  - The `Check Changeset` red at this head is that correction and nothing else. `check-empty-changeset.mjs` states it stays red by design, and `pr-automation.yml` runs it on `pull_request` only, not on `merge_group`.
- **Every other changed PR-body sentence is TRUE,** including the new Gates bullet (110 derived commands, reproduced).
- **Changeset `20041-like-nul-pattern-refused.md`:** every measured sentence is TRUE. Record 5828387721's only objection is gone.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-20041-like-nul-pattern-refused`
Reviewed-by: `session_01Bvd69VPa6puiNzzPUroDBx`

**VERDICT: PASS**
